faq.title: Everything to know before you rent
faq.paymentQuestion: Do I have to pay online?
faq.paymentAnswer: No. DriveTN never collects any payment: you pay the agency directly when you pick up the car.
faq.documentsAnswer: Your ID card or passport and a valid driving licence. Each agency states its own conditions (minimum age, years of driving).
faq.depositAnswer: The agency asks for a deposit at pick-up, using the methods it accepts, and returns it when you bring the car back.
faq.contactQuestion: How do I reach the agency?
faq.contactAnswer: As soon as your booking is sent, you can contact the agency by phone or WhatsApp.

welcome.metaDescription: DriveTN shows your agency to clients. You run the fleet, the bookings and the costs in one workspace.
welcome.title: Your agency online, from the booking to the costs
welcome.lead: Clients find you on DriveTN, book without paying online, and pay when you hand over the keys. You keep the fleet, the schedule, the collections and the costs in one place.
welcome.definitionTitle: DriveTN connects clients with your agency
welcome.definitionText: DriveTN is the site where someone in Tunisia looks for a car to rent. Your agency lists its fleet there. The client picks the dates and books without paying online. You confirm, hand over the keys, and record the payment you received. The schedule, the collections and the costs stay in the same workspace.
